description: Given mixed files/directories and filters, discovery returns the same canonical ordered set across repeated runs.
Loops, inaccessible paths, reparse points, aliases, and duplicate identities are handled according to policy without infinite traversal.
`doctor --json` emits a schema-valid capability report and performs no source writes.
`inspect` explains stored dimensions, EXIF transform, candidate evidence, proposed action, and blockers for one file.
Golden images for all EXIF Orientation values 1–8 render to the same intended upright view.
Candidate generation composes EXIF display transforms before additional rotational hypotheses.
Candidate scoring is deterministic for a pinned model, runtime, policy, and input.
Face detections expose bounding boxes, confidence, and five landmarks for each candidate.
No persisted artifact contains an identity embedding or cross-file face identifier.
Automation requires configured score, top-two margin, and minimum-evidence gates.
Ambiguous, no-face, contradictory multi-face, or out-of-distribution cases become REVIEW rather than forced rotations.
A job plan validates against its schema and records tool, policy, model, runtime, and source fingerprints.
Once sealed, plan rows cannot be edited through normal commands; review overrides are append-only decisions.
`scan` creates no image output and does not modify source timestamps, data streams, or metadata.
`apply` refuses a source changed after scan and emits a stable stale-plan result.
Safe-copy mode preserves relative paths and never overwrites an unrelated existing destination.
Collision behavior is deterministic, logged, and configurable as error, skip, or content-aware rename.
In-place mode cannot begin without explicit acknowledgement and a writable verified backup target.
Fault injection before atomic replacement leaves the source unchanged and a recoverable journal.
Fault injection after replacement but before final checkpoint is reconciled safely on restart.
Eligible JPEG rotations use the DCT-domain path without generation loss.
Non-MCU-aligned JPEG behavior follows the selected abort/reencode/trim/preserve-partial policy and is never silent.
Successful normalization writes display-equivalent upright pixels and sets orientation metadata to 1.
Required metadata fields pass the device/format round-trip corpus under the active preservation policy.
Verification reopens output and rejects decode failure, wrong dimensions, wrong orientation, or missing required metadata.
A verification failure prevents commit or triggers recovery without deleting the last known-good source.
Cancellation produces a resumable state and a documented partial-completion exit code.
Replaying a completed operation does not duplicate output or corrupt journal state.
Undo restores a byte-verified backup when the current file matches the expected applied state.
Undo refuses and reports conflict when the current file was independently changed.
Review decisions can be exported, edited with documented values, imported, validated, and appended to the job.
Review thumbnails are orientation-labeled, bounded in size, and stored only when explicitly enabled.
`--json` emits one schema-valid document; `--jsonl` emits independently parseable event lines.
With machine output selected, stdout contains no progress bars, ANSI styling, or unsolicited prose.
All documented result classes map to stable exit codes tested on Windows PowerShell and cmd.exe.
Configuration precedence is CLI > environment > explicit file > user file > defaults.
Unknown or invalid configuration fields fail before file processing unless forward-compatible mode is explicitly selected.
A model bundle with wrong digest, unsupported schema, or incompatible runtime is quarantined and never activated.
Model activation is atomic and rollback restores the prior verified model.
Format support is reported per operation; unsupported write/metadata combinations fail during planning rather than mid-commit.
Configured queue and worker limits bound memory under a 100,000-file synthetic workload.
Ctrl+C first requests graceful cancellation; a second interrupt terminates promptly with durable state.
Every file has a terminal event with action, result, reason code, timings, and provenance.
Default logs contain no image bytes and path redaction is available for support bundles.
Sequence consensus can break a bounded tie but cannot override hard safety or evidence gates.
Scene fallback remains disabled unless its evaluation report demonstrates statistically supported net benefit.
Benchmark output records hardware, OS, runtime, model, configuration, corpus descriptor, throughput, latency, and memory.
Generated PowerShell completion and UTF-8 response files handle spaces, Unicode, and long paths.
Job integrity detects missing artifacts, invalid schema, digest mismatch, illegal state transition, and orphaned temporary files.
Prune defaults to dry-run and cannot remove jobs with pending recovery or undo retention.
Demonstrate: No source file may be deleted, truncated, or replaced before a verified output and durable journal state exist. Target: 100% in fault-injection suite
Demonstrate: All mutating operations are idempotent or explicitly conflict-detecting under replay. Target: All replay scenarios pass
Demonstrate: The application shall detect stale plans using file identity and content fingerprints before apply. Target: Zero undetected mutations in test matrix
Demonstrate: A crash at any injected persistence boundary shall leave a recoverable, diagnosable state. Target: 100% crash-point recovery cases pass
Demonstrate: Precision is the primary release metric; coverage may not be increased by weakening the false-rotation ceiling. Target: Accepted selfie precision ≥99.5% on governed corpus
Demonstrate: Already-upright photos accepted for automation shall rarely be rotated incorrectly. Target: False rotation ≤0.1% on governed upright subset
Demonstrate: Target accepted-decision coverage only after precision targets are met. Target: Should target ≥85% selfie coverage

Demonstrate: Calibration shall be measured by orientation-, device-, demographic-, lighting-, and occlusion-aware slices. Target: No critical slice violates release ceiling without documented block/mitigation
Demonstrate: Memory usage shall be bounded independently of collection size. Target: Configurable ceiling; default working set target ≤1.5 GB on reference host
Demonstrate: Analysis shall avoid full-resolution decode when a bounded thumbnail is sufficient. Target: At least 95% of analyzed files use bounded decode path
Demonstrate: The pipeline shall keep CPU, GPU, storage, and metadata subprocess work bounded and observable. Target: No unbounded queue; stage metrics emitted
Demonstrate: Cold-start and single-file inspection shall remain practical on supported hardware. Target: Doctor <3 s and inspect p95 <2 s on reference host, excluding first model install
Demonstrate: Treat image files, metadata, model bundles, configuration, and job imports as untrusted input. Target: Threat-model controls and negative tests complete
Demonstrate: Third-party binaries and models shall be version-pinned, digest-verified, inventoried, and license-reviewed. Target: 100% production artifacts in SBOM and dependency register
Demonstrate: No arbitrary in-process third-party plugin loading in v1. Target: Plugin boundary policy enforced by architecture tests
Demonstrate: Core operation shall require no network access and shall not upload image pixels or metadata. Target: Network-denied end-to-end tests pass
Demonstrate: No face recognition, identity embeddings, or cross-file identity profiles may be created. Target: Design and binary review confirm absence
Demonstrate: Telemetry is disabled by default; diagnostic bundles redact paths unless explicitly requested. Target: Privacy review and golden diagnostics pass
Demonstrate: Destructive behavior shall require explicit, non-ambiguous flags and shall never be triggered by defaults. Target: CLI golden tests cover all destructive paths
Demonstrate: Human output shall be concise and actionable; machine output shall be stable, complete, and free of decoration. Target: Usability review plus schema/stream tests pass

Demonstrate: Primary release target is supported Windows 11 x64 with NTFS; behavior on ReFS, network shares, cloud placeholders, and removable media is capability-gated. Target: Published compatibility matrix backed by tests
Demonstrate: Paths shall support Unicode and Windows long-path semantics without lossy normalization. Target: Path conformance matrix passes
Demonstrate: Governed metadata preservation shall be field-aware and validated, not implemented as an unqualified byte-copy promise. Target: Metadata corpus round-trip policy passes
Demonstrate: JPEGs shall not be recompressed when a safe DCT-domain rotation is possible. Target: Coefficient or lossless-equivalence checks pass
Demonstrate: Domain policy shall not depend directly on CLI, storage engine, model runtime, or native codec implementation. Target: Architecture conformance tests pass
Demonstrate: All externally consumed schemas and exit codes shall be versioned with compatibility policy. Target: Contract compatibility suite passes
Demonstrate: Every job shall expose correlation IDs, stage timings, warnings, failure categories, runtime/model versions, and reproducibility data. Target: Support bundle completeness test passes
Demonstrate: Logs shall remain bounded through rotation/retention and shall not include image bytes. Target: Soak and privacy tests pass
